verdict.rationale: Buzz keeps its data in open formats you can reach directly. Repos can be pulled from Buzz's own git server with standard git, chat is stored as Nostr events that any third-party NIP-29 client can read from the relay, and the platform is self-hostable on Postgres/Redis/S3. There is no documented export feature, so getting all your data out depends on these open-protocol access paths rather than a dedicated export. missing for 10: a documented full-account or workspace export tool, coverage of all data types (canvases, workflows, huddles, agent memory, uploads), documented export formats and procedure, and hands-on corroboration of leaving with complete data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
